dialogues.speaker: Caron
dialogues.text: Clocks — or to be more precisely, exquisite clockwork-powered clocks — are our family craft, famous throughout Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Caron
dialogues.text: Have you heard of the Lady of the Lake's Tear?

dialogues.speaker: Caron
dialogues.text: That was the name Lady Furina gave to one of my works.

dialogues.speaker: Caron
dialogues.text: What a lovely name, like a song that encapsulates such sadness.
